sign_in_first: Sign in to the hub on the web first, then open this page.
offline: {name} is offline. Try again once it's back.
no_extension: Neither the computer control nor the browser (ego lite) extension is on, or this isn't a Mac.
extension_off: Computer control or Browser isn't on for this Mac yet. Turn one on from its machine page.
sharing_off: Screen Sharing is off on this Mac. Turn it on in System Settings › General › Sharing.
not_found: This machine isn't on the hub, or isn't a Mac.
unauthorized_app: The hub didn't accept this device's credentials. Pair again in the app under Settings › hub.
unauthorized_web: The hub didn't accept these credentials. Sign in to the hub again on the web.
kept_password_wrong: The saved password no longer works (the Mac's password may have changed). Enter it again; it replaces the saved one once connected.
connection_lost: Connection lost: the Mac's Screen Sharing stopped responding, or the network dropped.
title: {name}'s screen
signin_title: Sign in to this Mac's Screen Sharing
signin_hint_kept: Use your macOS account and password on {name}. They go only to that Mac; if remembered, they're kept in this device's keychain and never uploaded.
signin_hint: Use your macOS account and password on {name}. They go only to that Mac and aren't saved.
